enEffect: For every 1 point of fall, squeeze, suffocation, wither, fire and poison damage taken, you gain 0.5/0.75/1 "Abnormal Joy" point(s).
For every 1 point of damage taken from cacti, sweet berry bushes and projectiles, you gain 0.5/0.75/1 "Abnormal Joy" point(s).

While you are on fire or in lava, taking any damage other than fire and lava damage grants you 20/15/10s of "Nausea" and "Slowness", but all nearby hostile mobs and attackers suffer 200%/250%/300% of that damage.
While you are swimming, taking any damage grants you 20/15/10s of "Nausea" and "Blindness", but all nearby hostile mobs and attackers suffer 200%/250%/300% of that damage.
For every 1 point of magic, lightning and explosion damage taken, you gain 0.5/0.75/1 "Abnormal Joy" point(s).
Inflicts 8/9/10s of "Agony Resonance" of the corresponding level on the attacked target.

Bow attack damage is reduced to 10% of the default value. Inflicts 2/4/6/8/10s of "Listen to Me Singing" of the corresponding level on the attacked target. At the same time, you also suffer an 80% slowness effect for 2/4/6/8/10s.

Sword attack damage is reduced to 10% of the default value. Any creature you attack will be almost unable to follow any target normally for 3/5/7s, and during this period it will be struck by lightning once every 0.5s; each lightning strike deals 2-4 points of damage that ignores armor.

Sword attack damage is reduced to 10% of the default value. Any creature you attack will be almost unable to follow any target normally for 3/5/7s, and during this period it takes 5-8 points of magic damage every 1s.

When you break a melon, all nearby monsters will suffer 200%-300% of the tool's attack damage. If you trigger the enchantment effect at night, the damage dealt will be increased to 400%-600% times. At the same time, the tool loses 5 points of durability.
Synergy: [Silk Touch] damage is reduced to 50% of the tool's attack damage, but there is an additional 2.5% chance to drop a head, and this chance is affected by [Fortune]. [Fortune] drops will be increased. [Unbreaking] the tool's durability loss is adjusted to 4/4/3 points.
This enchantment was removed in the Backport 1.15.2 version.
